title: Code, prompts and data for: Do multimodal language models defer to a clinician's wrong ECG read? A controlled study of sycophancy in 12-lead ECG interpretation
description: Code, prompts, case list, rendered ECG images (derived from PTB-XL, CC BY 4.0), raw responses of eight multimodal large language models and analysis scripts for a controlled study of sycophancy in 12-lead ECG interpretation. Code is MIT-licensed; data are CC BY 4.0.
